evidence: ref27/System/Applications/FindMy.app/Contents/Info.plist via bifrost pc ref extract (URL schemes grenada, findmyfriends, fmf1, findmy, fmip1; user activities LocateDeviceIntent, LocateIntent, PlaySoundIntent, ToggleLocationSharingIntent; contacts and location usage strings; regulatory privacy disclosure keys for camera, contacts, location; extension FindMyNotificationsService.appex)

ref27/System/Applications/FindMy.app/Contents/PlugIns/FindMyNotificationsService.appex (the only other file in the bundle; the UI is in private frameworks, so the feature list also follows the shipped app's documented behaviour)
No BifrOSt source: grep of springboard for the feature finds only springboard/docs/parity/windows-spaces.md (unrelated)

features.apple: Find My app with People, Devices, Items and Me tabs
features.note: BifrOSt has no such app and no listing in the app list.
features.wire: Create springboard/apps/findmy-desktop (new crate; copy the layout of apps/weather-desktop: manifest.toml, Cargo.toml, src/main.rs, src/window.rs) with a source_list sidebar (People, Devices, Items) and a map pane using the bifrost-maps model crate (apps/maps-desktop), registered in the shell app list.

features.apple: List of the account's devices with last known location on a map and battery state
features.note: Devices sign in to BifrOSt Account (bifrost-cloud) but report no location.
features.wire: Add POST /api/cloud/devices/{id}/location (latitude, longitude, accuracy, battery, timestamp) and GET /api/cloud/devices to ~/Projects/bifrost-cloud, have the shell upload its location when a location service exists, and list them in the app.

features.feature: Play a sound on a device
features.apple: Play Sound (PlaySoundIntent) to find a nearby device
features.note: No remote commands to a device.
features.wire: Add a command queue to the cloud device record (play_sound, lock, erase) polled by the shell's cloud sync, and a Play Sound button in the device card; honour the no-unasked-sound rule by requiring the person to press the button.

features.apple: Mark as lost with a contact message and lock
features.wire: Add a lost flag and message to the cloud device record; the shell lock screen shows the message and phone number when the flag is set.
Add an erase command to the queue; the shell confirms the signed command and runs the factory reset path of the installer.

features.apple: Directions button opens the maps app
features.note: No maps window and no device positions.
features.wire: Open the Maps app with a route request (the maps: URL scheme from the Maps inventory) to the device position.

features.apple: Notify When Found and Notify When Left Behind
features.note: No notification pipeline from the cloud.
features.wire: Add push-style long polling from the shell to the cloud device endpoint and post a shell notification on the event.

features.apple: Share location with contacts for an hour, a day or indefinitely (ToggleLocationSharingIntent)
features.wire: Add share grants (from, to, until) to the cloud account API and a Share My Location sheet that picks Contacts entries by BifrOSt Account address.

features.apple: Friends on a map with distance, and notifications when someone arrives or leaves
features.wire: Return granted friends' latest positions from the cloud API and draw them as pins with name and distance; add Notify Me rules (arrives, leaves) per friend.

features.apple: Tags and accessories on the finding network with separation alerts
features.note: Needs the vendor's crowd-sourced finding network and tag hardware, which BifrOSt has no equivalent of.

features.apple: Locate a device that is off or offline through nearby devices
features.note: Depends on the vendor's finding network.

features.apple: Device stays tied to the account after an erase
features.note: Hardware and boot-chain feature; the installer has no such attestation.

features.feature: Me tab: this device and location settings
features.apple: Share My Location switch, device name, location services state (NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription)
features.wire: Add a Me page with the share switch, this device's name from BifrOSt Account and the location authorization state.

features.note: No consent flow in an app that does not exist.
features.wire: Ask for the contacts permission with the shell's permission prompt when the person opens Share My Location.
Expose locate, play_sound and share as app control methods (bifrost-app-control).

features.apple: findmy:, findmyfriends:, fmf1:, fmip1:, grenada: schemes
features.wire: Register a findmy: scheme in the new manifest that opens a device or person by id.

features.note: No extension model for notifications from an app.
features.wire: Deliver through the shell notification centre from the cloud poll in the new app's background helper.

features.apple: First-run onboarding bundle and privacy disclosure
features.wire: Add a first-run sheet that explains what is uploaded (device position, battery) and links the BifrOSt Account privacy page.
